description:
We are a creative and enthusiastic team interested in space technology, AI, web development, and Earth science. Our goal is to build an innovative and interactive project using NASA data to explore environmental changes on Earth.

We are looking for passionate teammates interested in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, web development, UI/UX design, and research. Beginners with creative ideas and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

Let's collaborate, innovate, and create something meaningful!
